results.title: QApilot: Mobile-First Businesses Need Mobile-First App Testing | Product Hunt
results.content:
I ve been researching pre-submission checks for mobile apps. Apple rejected 1.93M of 7.77M submissions in 2024. Google says it blocked over 1.75M policy-violating apps in 2025.

I went through 25 tools that try to catch issues before review. That includes fastlane precheck, Greenlight, Google s pre-review checks and Play Policy Insights, Checks by Google, and several newer AI reviewers. Most check metadata or code. Very few check what the app actually does at runtime against store policy, and none I found publish their accuracy against real rejections.
